items.title: Lesson Podcast
items.description: Audio guide to encoding, storage and retrieval, and the three types of long-term memory.

items.title: All in the Mind — BBC Radio 4
items.description: Claudia Hammond's Radio 4 series regularly covers memory research — many episodes explore episodic, semantic and procedural memory.

items.title: How Memories Form and How We Lose Them — TED-Ed
items.description: Animated TED-Ed lesson explaining encoding and consolidation — the biological basis of how memories are created and stored.

items.title: Memory: GCSE Psychology
items.description: Concise AQA GCSE revision video covering encoding, storage and retrieval alongside the types of long-term memory.

items.title: How Memory Works — The 3 Types Explained
items.description: Short explainer breaking down episodic, semantic and procedural memory with everyday examples accessible to GCSE students.

items.title: 50 First Dates
items.description: Comedy about a woman who cannot form new long-term memories — illustrates the distinction between episodic memory loss and procedural memory retention.

items.title: Simply Psychology — Memory: Encoding, Storage and Retrieval
items.description: Comprehensive notes on all three memory processes and the different types of long-term memory — ideal revision companion.

items.title: tutor2u Psychology
items.description: Revision resources, quizzes and topic summaries for AQA GCSE Psychology including the memory unit.
